purpose: Web app where DeMolay-RO chapter officers submit state campaign activities and reviewers grade them.

agent_rules.R01: DO NOT write from scratch what a maintained free library already does. Name the library before coding.
agent_rules.R02: Follow official Supabase docs for Auth, RLS, Storage, Edge Functions. No custom auth, no custom crypto, no custom session handling.
agent_rules.R03: Free tiers only. No dependency requiring a credit card or paid plan.
agent_rules.R04: One table or one screen per change. Small diffs. Run build + lint + tests before declaring done.
agent_rules.R05: Never install a package without stating name and reason. Prefer packages with recent releases and high usage.
agent_rules.R06: Authorization lives in the database (RLS), never only in the UI.
agent_rules.R07: No secrets in code or in git. Only VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY reach the client.
agent_rules.R08: Validate every input with zod on client and on server (Edge Function / DB constraints).
agent_rules.R09: Never log personal data. Never put personal data in URLs.
agent_rules.R10: Email + password auth only. No OAuth providers.

email.auth_emails: custom SMTP configured in Supabase Auth (free provider: Brevo or Resend)
email.app_emails: Edge Function calling provider HTTP API with official SDK or fetch
email.note: Built-in Supabase mailer is rate-limited; do not rely on it.

roles.member: chapter officer; submits activities for own chapter; requires status=approved
roles.reviewer: grades submissions of all chapters; cannot manage users
roles.admin: reviewer + approve/reject users + manage campaigns, activities, chapters

profiles: id uuid pk fk auth.users on delete cascade
attachments: submission_id uuid fk on delete cascade
comments: submission_id uuid fk on delete cascade

db_helpers.is_approved(): security definer; true if auth.uid() has profiles.status='approved'
db_helpers.current_role(): security definer; returns profiles.role for auth.uid()
db_helpers.current_chapter(): security definer; returns profiles.chapter_id for auth.uid()
db_helpers.trigger_on_signup: after insert on auth.users -> insert profiles(status='pending', role='member')
db_helpers.trigger_protect_profile: before update on profiles: if actor is not admin, block changes to role, status, chapter_id
db_helpers.trigger_audit: after insert/update/delete on submissions(score,status), profiles(role,status) -> audit_log
db_helpers.set_search_path: all security definer functions must set search_path = public

rls.global: ENABLE and FORCE RLS on every table in public. Default deny. Never create 'using (true)' policies for authenticated.

profiles.update: admin only (members may update only full_name, via trigger guard)
profiles.insert: none from client (created by signup trigger)

submissions.select: is_approved() AND (chapter_id = current_chapter() OR current_role() in ('reviewer','admin'))
submissions.insert: is_approved() AND chapter_id = current_chapter() AND submitted_by = auth.uid() AND status in ('draft','submitted')
submissions.update_member: is_approved() AND chapter_id = current_chapter() AND status in ('draft','returned') AND score is not changed
submissions.update_reviewer: current_role() in ('reviewer','admin'); may set status in ('returned','approved'), score, reviewed_by, reviewed_at
submissions.delete: member only own draft; admin any

attachments.insert: only on own chapter's submission with status in ('draft','returned')

comments.insert: any user who can see the submission; author_id = auth.uid()

storage.policies: mirror attachments table policies; members only inside own chapter_id prefix; reviewers/admins read all
storage.access: signed URLs only, expiry <= 300s, generated on demand
storage.client_checks: mime + size before upload; rename file to uuid; never trust filename

auth_flow: S1 signup(email, password, full_name, chapter_id, position, terms_accepted=true) via supabase.auth.signUp; email confirmation REQUIRED
S2 trigger creates profiles row status=pending
S3 pending user can sign in but router shows only /awaiting-approval; DB denies all data via is_approved()
S4 Edge Function notify_new_signup (DB webhook on profiles insert) emails all reviewers/admins
S5 admin approves/rejects in /admin/users; update writes status + audit_log
S6 Edge Function notify_user_decision (DB webhook on profiles.status update) emails the user: approved or rejected
S7 on approval user gets full access on next session refresh

S8 password reset: /forgot-password -> supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail (captcha, generic response) -> email link -> /reset-password (PASSWORD_RECOVERY session) -> supabase.auth.updateUser({password}) -> signOut -> /login
S9 reset emails go through the custom SMTP; Supabase Redirect URLs allowlist must include /reset-password

auth_rules.leaked_password_protection: enable in Supabase Auth settings if available
auth_rules.signup_captcha: Cloudflare Turnstile or hCaptcha on signup and login
auth_rules.email_domain_policy: chapter email as provided; optional allowlist table (allowed_emails) checked in signup trigger, reject if not listed
auth_rules.session: supabase-js default; no tokens in localStorage manually; sign out on role change

routes.guards: RouteGuard component checks session, status=approved, role; UI guard is convenience only (R06)

member: list open campaigns and activities with due date and points
submit activity: description + up to 5 attachments
reviewer: table of submissions with filters: chapter, campaign, activity, status
review screen: preview attachment via signed URL, set score <= activity.points, approve or return with comment

security_requirements.S01: RLS enabled and forced on all tables; verified by tests as each role.
security_requirements.S02: service_role key only inside Edge Functions secrets; never in client, repo or logs.
security_requirements.S03: Privilege escalation blocked: members cannot change own role/status/chapter (trigger + policy).
security_requirements.S04: Reviewer score validated server-side: 0 <= score <= activities.points.
security_requirements.S05: Private storage bucket + signed URLs short-lived + mime/size enforced.
security_requirements.S06: All forms validated with zod; DB constraints mirror limits.
security_requirements.S07: Render user text as plain text. If HTML is ever needed, sanitize with DOMPurify. No dangerouslySetInnerHTML with raw input.
security_requirements.S08: Security headers set in the static host config: Content-Security-Policy (self + Supabase origin + captcha origin), X-Content-Type-Options nosniff, Referrer-Policy strict-origin-when-cross-origin, frame-ancestors 'none'.
security_requirements.S09: CAPTCHA on signup/login; rely on Supabase Auth rate limits; generic error messages (no user enumeration).
security_requirements.S10: Edge Functions: verify JWT, verify caller role, validate payload, verify webhook secret, no open email relay (recipient list built server-side, never from request body).
security_requirements.S11: audit_log for approvals, role changes, score changes.
security_requirements.S12: Minimal admins (<= 3); document 2FA requirement for admins on GitHub, Supabase, email accounts.
security_requirements.S13: Dependencies: lockfile committed; run npm audit; enable Dependabot; no abandoned packages.
security_requirements.S14: Backup routine: scheduled export script (pg_dump or CSV via Supabase) stored outside Supabase; document restore steps.
security_requirements.S15: Fail closed: on any authorization doubt, deny.

lgpd_requirements.L01: Data minimization: only full_name, chapter email, chapter, position, submission content. No CPF, address, phone.
lgpd_requirements.L02: Privacy policy and terms pages; signup requires explicit acceptance; store terms_accepted_at.
lgpd_requirements.L03: Many users may be under 18: show guardian-consent notice; store guardian_consent_at when required by the Order's process; apply best-interest principle (LGPD art. 14).
lgpd_requirements.L04: Attachments guidance in UI: avoid identifiable faces of minors unless authorized.
lgpd_requirements.L05: Data subject rights: contact email on /privacy; admin function to export and delete a user's data (cascade delete profile, submissions, attachments, storage objects).
lgpd_requirements.L06: Retention: configurable job/script to delete submissions and attachments N months after campaign end.
lgpd_requirements.L07: Access restricted by role; personal data visible only to reviewers/admins and the owner chapter.
lgpd_requirements.L08: Incident plan documented in docs/INCIDENT.md: rotate keys, revoke sessions, notify affected users and the Order.
lgpd_requirements.L09: No analytics/trackers or third-party scripts that collect personal data.

tests_required: member of chapter A cannot select submissions of chapter B
pending user cannot select any data table
rejected user cannot select any data table
member cannot update own role, status or chapter_id
member cannot set score or approve own submission
reviewer cannot change user role or status
reviewer score above activity.points is rejected
upload with disallowed mime or size > 5 MB is rejected
storage object of chapter B not readable by member of chapter A
unauthenticated request returns nothing on every table
signup creates profile with status=pending and role=member regardless of client payload
Edge Functions reject calls without valid JWT or webhook secret
forgot-password shows the same generic message for registered and unregistered emails
reset-password without a recovery session shows the invalid/expired link state and never calls updateUser
reset-password rejects passwords shorter than 10 characters or a mismatched confirmation
after a successful password update the user is signed out and redirected to /login
pending and rejected users can open /forgot-password and /reset-password
smoke check in dev and in the production build: deep links to, and client-side navigation between, all routes render fully styled pages with no CSS, 404, MIME or CSP errors
grep check: the old site name 'DeMolay Rondônia' does not appear in src/, index.html, public/ or supabase/functions/
definition_of_done: tsc, eslint, build and tests pass
README lists env vars and setup of Supabase, SMTP and webhooks
S01-S15 and L01-L09 each mapped to implemented code or documented gap

B2 RLS policies + storage policies + tests_required (DB level)
B3 auth screens + approval gate + awaiting-approval
B5 campaigns/activities read for members + admin CRUD

B12 [U2] password reset: /forgot-password + /reset-password + login link + RouteGuard allowances + tests; document Supabase dashboard steps in README

update_requests.how_to_use: Execute B11-B17 in order, one step per change (R04). update.txt holds the same requests in prose with more context.
update_requests.scope_note: Front-end only. No changes to schema, RLS, storage or Edge Function logic. Repo config files (vercel.json, vite.config.ts, index.html, tailwind config) are in scope; hosting or account operations stay out_of_scope, so document dashboard steps in README instead of automating them.

U1_css_bug.symptom: CSS is intermittently missing: some pages are styled and others are not. It happens on localhost (npm run dev) AND in production, so the cause is in the project code or config, not in Vercel.
U1_css_bug.principle: Because it reproduces locally, debug locally first with the dev server. Production-only causes (cache headers, rewrites, CSP, project settings) are checked last, and only if the bug still appears in the deployed build.
diagnose_first: on localhost open a failing route and inspect an unstyled element in DevTools Elements: is the class on the element but with no matching rule (Tailwind did not generate it), or is the whole stylesheet missing (Network, filter CSS)?
DevTools Network: is the main stylesheet requested on the failing route, with status 200 and content-type text/css?

check the dev server terminal and the browser Console for Tailwind or PostCSS errors, 'Failed to resolve import', 'Failed to fetch dynamically imported module', CSS parse errors and the Vite error overlay

record when it happens: first load, client-side navigation between pages, hard refresh, or after saving a file (HMR). Also test whether it disappears after deleting node_modules/.vite and restarting the dev server
compare 'npm run dev' with 'npm run build && npm run preview': failing in both points to config or CSS import structure; failing only in preview points to purge, minification or chunking
likely_causes: C1 Tailwind content globs do not cover every folder that holds classes (src/components/ui, src/pages, index.html...). Classes used only in uncovered files are never generated, so only some pages look broken. Check tailwind.config content (v3) or source detection (v4) and components.json

C2 global CSS imported in the wrong place: index.css (with the Tailwind directives or import) must be imported exactly once, in src/main.tsx, never inside a page or lazy component. Remove leftover Vite template CSS (App.css, duplicated index.css) and make sure there is a single Tailwind setup (no v3 and v4 mixed, no tailwind.config together with a conflicting @theme)

C3 CSS imported by individual route components or lazy chunks (import './Page.css'): load order changes with navigation, so one page's rules override or leak into another, and a failed lazy chunk drops that page's styles. Move shared rules to the global file or to Tailwind classes and avoid unscoped page CSS

C4 relative stylesheet or asset URLs (<link href='styles.css'>, url(images/x.png) in CSS, public/ files referenced without a leading slash) break on nested routes like /my-submissions/123, in dev and in production. Use absolute paths starting with '/' and vite base '/'
C5 dynamically built class names (bg-${color}-500) are never generated by Tailwind, and neither are classes that come from the database. Use full literal class names or a lookup map
C6 PostCSS or Vite config problems: missing or misnamed postcss config, wrong plugin (@tailwindcss/vite vs PostCSS plugin), duplicated configs (.js and .cjs), stale cache in node_modules/.vite

C7 shadcn/ui setup: components.json css path points to a file that is not the one imported, CSS variables (--background, --foreground, --primary...) missing from :root, or the dark class toggled inconsistently, so some components render without colors
C8 filename or case mismatch in imports and assets (spaces, accents, Logo.png vs logo.png). Works on Windows and macOS, fails on Linux builds. Use lowercase ASCII kebab-case names

C9 production only, check last: stale index.html pointing to removed hashed files after a deploy, SPA fallback returning index.html for a missing asset (CSS served as text/html), CSP from S08 blocking inline styles used by shadcn/Radix, Vercel project settings (Framework Preset Vite, build 'npm run build', output 'dist', Node version in package.json engines, lockfile committed; dashboard step, document in README)
production_hardening_only_if_deployed_bu: Cache-Control no-cache on index.html and 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable' on /assets/*
listener for the 'vite:preloadError' event that reloads the page once
vercel.json: /assets/* is never rewritten; the SPA fallback applies only to non-file paths
CSP: allow 'unsafe-inline' for style-src only, never loosen script-src
U1_css_bug.if_cause_not_found: stop and report instead of guessing: the failing routes, DevTools Elements and Network evidence, tailwind and postcss/vite configs, src/main.tsx and index.css
acceptance: with 'npm run dev', every route is fully styled on first load, on client-side navigation between all routes and on hard refresh of a deep link
same result with 'npm run build && npm run preview' and on the deployed site
no CSS, PostCSS or Tailwind errors in the terminal or Console; no 404, MIME or CSP errors in Network on /login and /campaigns
a smoke test or a documented manual checklist visits every route
confirmed root cause written in the PR description and docs/CHANGELOG.md; no fixes applied for causes that were not observed

U2_password_reset.library: supabase-js built-in resetPasswordForEmail and updateUser (R01, R02). No custom tokens.
flow: add the link 'Esqueci minha senha' on /login pointing to /forgot-password

/forgot-password: form with email and captcha token. Call supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, { redirectTo: window.location.origin + '/reset-password', captchaToken }). Always show the same message: 'Se o e-mail estiver cadastrado, você receberá um link para redefinir a senha.' (S09). Disable the button for 60 seconds after sending

/reset-password: listen to supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange for the 'PASSWORD_RECOVERY' event and also check for an existing recovery session. Without one, show 'Link inválido ou expirado' with a button to /forgot-password and do not call updateUser

form with new password and confirmation, validated with zod: min 10 characters (auth_rules.password_min_length) and both fields equal. Call supabase.auth.updateUser({ password }). On success call supabase.auth.signOut(), show a success notice and redirect to /login
RouteGuard must let both routes through for any user, including pending and rejected, and must not redirect a user in a recovery session before the password is changed
never log the email or tokens (R09); never parse the token from the URL manually, supabase-js handles it
manual_steps_document_in_readme: Supabase Authentication > URL Configuration: add production URL, /reset-password and localhost to Redirect URLs
Supabase Authentication > Email Templates: set 'Reset Password' and 'Confirm signup' in pt-BR with the new site name
confirm custom SMTP is configured (built-in mailer is rate-limited)
acceptance: full flow works: request link, open email, set new password, sign in with it
tests listed in tests_required for password reset pass

rename.single_source: src/config/site.ts exports SITE_NAME; use it everywhere
rename.keep_when: the text refers to the Order DeMolay itself and not to the site name
rename.legal_pages: on /privacy and /terms change only the name and leave a PR note requesting human review of the legal text

brand_assets.reference_role: This file is THE visual reference for the whole rebranding: read it (open the image) before any design work. Colors, mood, shapes and level of formality of the new UI must follow what is in this emblem. Do not move, rename, edit or delete it; keep it in img/ as the source of truth.
brand_assets.target_note: copy the source to target (the original keeps its name in img/); the app imports only the copy, never the file in img/
brand_assets.rules: lowercase ASCII kebab-case filenames for everything the app references (see C8), which is why the copy is renamed; width and height attributes on images; alt='Emblema Virtudes Atemporais'

palette.method: Sample the dominant blue, green and gold directly from img/EMBLEMA VIRTUDES ATEMPORAIS.png with an eyedropper, or with a throwaway node-vibrant script run against that path and not kept as an app dependency. Do not guess hex values. Record them, with the source path, in docs/design-tokens.md.
palette.tokens: define CSS variables in src/index.css mapped to shadcn tokens: --primary (blue), --secondary and --accent (green), a gold token for highlights, neutral grays. No hardcoded hex inside components.
palette.contrast: WCAG AA: 4.5:1 for body text, 3:1 for large text. Gold usually fails as text on white, so use it for borders, icons, badges, dividers and large headings on dark blue; use dark blue for text and buttons.

design_direction: visual reference is img/EMBLEMA VIRTUDES ATEMPORAIS.png: the palette and overall feel of every screen must be consistent with it (see brand_assets and palette)
modern and clean: spacing in multiples of 8 px, max-width container, rounded-lg, soft shadows, no heavy gradients
app shell: header with emblem + SITE_NAME + user menu; collapsible left sidebar on authenticated screens that becomes a Sheet drawer on mobile
login and signup: two columns on desktop (brand-color panel with emblem and a short tagline, form on white); form only with the emblem on top on small screens
typography: Inter via @fontsource-variable/inter, self-hosted (no Google Fonts CDN, see L09 and S08)
components: shadcn/ui only (Button, Card, Badge, Table, Dialog, Sheet, Tabs, Form, Skeleton, Sonner)
status badges always with text: draft gray, submitted blue, returned amber, approved green
Skeleton loaders, empty states with a call to action, inline pt-BR form errors, visible focus rings
mobile first; verify at 360, 768 and 1280 px; tables become cards or scroll horizontally on mobile
constraints: visual changes only: keep routes, props, hooks, queries, zod schemas, RouteGuard behavior and RLS-dependent calls unchanged
no new data fetching, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML (S07), no third-party scripts or fonts (L09)
new packages only with name and reason (R05); allowed candidates: @fontsource-variable/inter, sonner, lucide-react (if not already included by shadcn)
acceptance: searching for the old site name in src/, index.html, public/ and supabase/functions/ returns nothing, except references to the Order DeMolay itself
no component contains a hardcoded hex color; everything uses tokens
Lighthouse Accessibility score of 90 or more on /login and /campaigns
all screens checked at 360, 768 and 1280 px
